description.zh: 具有扩展网段的代播实例的主网段。如果查询的代播实例没有扩展网段，此参数为空。
description.en: The primary CIDR block of the anti-DDoS diversion instance for which an extended CIDR block is configured. If no extended CIDR blocks are configured for the anti-DDoS diversion instance, leave this parameter empty.

description.zh:
调度模式。取值：

- manual : 人工。
- netflow-auto：netflow自动调度。
description.en:
The scheduling mode. Valid values:

- manual: manual scheduling.

- netflow-auto: automatic scheduling.

description.zh:
代播实例的网段。
> 代播实例没有扩展网段时，表示实例的网段。代播实例有扩展网段时，表示扩展的网段，与MainNet参数配合使用。
description.en:
The CIDR block of the anti-DDoS diversion instance.

> If no extended CIDR blocks are configured for the anti-DDoS diversion instance, this parameter specifies the CIDR block of the instance. If an extended CIDR block is configured for the anti-DDoS diversion instance, this parameter specifies the extended CIDR block that is configured for the instance. If this parameter is specified, the MainNet parameter is required.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 100.
The ID of the anti-DDoS diversion instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosdiversion query-net-list --sale-id ddos_diversion_public_cn-xxxxxxxxxxxxx --net 192.168.XX.XX/24 --biz-mode netflow-auto --main-net 192.168.XX.XX/22 --page 1 --num 100 --region cn-hangzhou
